title: erigeron granatensis
intro: Erigeron granatensis, commonly known as the Royal Flower of the Gods or the "Mountain Fleabane", is a flowering plant native to the high-altitude regions of the Andes in South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, thanks to its health benefits of reducing oxidative stress, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron granatensis include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds are believed to be responsible for the plant's ability to modulate the immune response, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity.
